title: Hanford completes a 2,000-gallon treatment-to-disposal Test Bed Initiative cohort
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reports approximately 2,000 gallons of Hanford tank waste treated, radioactivity reduced by more than 99 percent, transported, grouted, and permanently disposed at licensed facilities. Denominator: One approximately-2,000-gallon Test Bed Initiative demonstration cohort completed across treatment, transport, grouting, and licensed permanent disposal.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Accepted disposal and closed-loop outcome.
